verdict.root_cause: cartservice cannot start because the Redis address it was handed is wrong. A platform-automation environment edit ~2 minutes before onset set REDIS_ADDR=redis-cart:6380 from a previously unset state and was never reverted [tr_cbc753c16772]. From ~09:56 cartservice crash-loops: startup dials redis-cart:6380, fails, and dies with an unhandled exception from the cart store's initialize/connect path called by program main, never reaching request handling [tr_dc63bf488e69]. With cartservice dead or restarting, checkoutservice's outbound CartService/GetCart span carries the error in 10/10 traces and propagates up through PlaceOrder to the frontend root [tr_2f62a6ad61ab], explaining the simultaneous checkoutservice/frontend/loadgenerator alerts while checkoutservice itself shows no change [tr_43aa54226209], no error-ratio shift [tr_dec0bdf34849], and only order-start log lines with no completion sequence [tr_73a852d2f6ba]. The wrong port value is the mechanism.
verdict.reasoning: Direction of blame: traces put error status on the deepest leaf, checkoutservice's outbound GetCart, with frontend and checkoutservice spans inheriting it; checkoutservice's internal spans show 0.1-0.3ms self time and no local error, and no other downstream edge appears, excluding the four unmeasured edges [tr_2f62a6ad61ab]. checkoutservice's empty change log [tr_43aa54226209] and baseline-level error ratio [tr_dec0bdf34849] make it the noticer. Mechanism: cartservice is not degraded but dead-and-restarting, with stacks bottoming out in startup Redis connect rather than any RPC handler [tr_dc63bf488e69] - which is why GetCart fails fast with sub-millisecond leaf durations and no latency inflation [tr_2f62a6ad61ab]. Why the value is the fault: the dialed port is non-default (6380 vs 6379), the edit landed ~2m before onset from unset, has no revert, and the identical edit earlier that day was backed out within 9 minutes [tr_cbc753c16772]. Competing cartservice changes fail on timing - hotfix image reverted ~31m before onset, 300ms traffic-shaping sidecar removed ~11m before onset [tr_cbc753c16772]; cartservice error metrics are vacuous in both windows [tr_018d7743a08b].
open_questions: redis-cart was never queried: it is unsettled whether nothing listens on 6380 (value simply wrong) or Redis was intentionally moved there and a missing listener, policy, or DNS blocks the path.

The 20-40s hang before each connect failure [tr_dc63bf488e69] reads as unreachable address or packet drop rather than refusal on a closed port; residual network-namespace state from the removed shaping sidecar was not examined.

checkoutservice logs were truncated, so onset between 09:27 and 09:56 is unobserved [tr_73a852d2f6ba]; nine of twelve blast-radius services were never dispatched, and the checkoutservice change query covered the seed only at 0 hops [tr_43aa54226209].

alternatives.root_cause: redis-cart is itself unavailable or not listening where cartservice expects, so startup connect fails regardless of whether 6380 is the intended port.
alternatives.why_not: No dispatch touched redis-cart, so this is unmeasured rather than supported, while the unreverted address edit two minutes before onset is directly observed [tr_cbc753c16772]. Promotes above the primary if redis-cart proves to listen on 6380.

alternatives.root_cause: Residual network-namespace state from the traffic-shaping container blackholes cartservice egress to Redis, causing the long connect hangs.
alternatives.why_not: The sidecar was removed ~11 minutes before onset and never re-attached [tr_cbc753c16772], and the observed failure is a hard startup exception rather than slow-but-successful calls [tr_dc63bf488e69].

proposal.expected_effect: Restoring cartservice's pre-09:54:19 environment (REDIS_ADDR unset, i.e. default 6379) and recreating it should end the startup crash-loop: the repeating connect-to-redis-cart:6380 -> failure -> unhandled ApplicationException cycle stops appearing in cart-service logs, normal GetCartAsync/AddItemAsync info lines resume, and in Tempo the checkoutservice CartService/GetCart leaf returns OK instead of ERROR in 10/10 traces, with ERROR clearing from PlaceOrder and the frontend root. checkout-service logs should again show payment/email/message-write completion lines after each order-start.
proposal.if_wrong: Falsified if cart-service logs still show the connect-then-exception cycle from Program main after the revert - especially if it now dials 6379 and still hangs 20-40s, which would mean the port value was not the mechanism and redis-cart is unreachable by path, policy, or DNS (never queried). cartservice error-ratio metrics cannot confirm this (calls_total absent in both windows), so confirmation rests on cart-service logs and checkoutservice traces only.
proposal.risk: If Redis was intentionally moved to 6380 and the real blocker is a missing listener or blocked path, this points cartservice at a port where nothing listens either: outage unchanged, plus one more config mutation on a service platform-automation is already cycling. The recreate discards in-process cart state and loses in-flight mutations; if automation re-applies 6380 the fix is transient.
proposal.blast_radius: cartservice during the recreate; its callers frontend and checkoutservice see connection resets on an edge already erroring, visible to loadgenerator via frontend. redis-cart sees cart traffic move from 6380 back to 6379.

triage_judgement.reasoning: Simultaneous critical alerts on checkout and frontend plus the load generator indicate user-facing failure, not a quiet system. No open incident could account for it, and the shared downstream set gives no single prior yet.
